<!-- docs-drift-check -->
### 📓 Docs Drift Check
This PR changes **4** package(s): `@objectstack/knowledge-memory`, `@objectstack/knowledge-pgvector`, `@objectstack/service-knowledge`, `@objectstack/spec`, touching **42** documentable anchor(s). ⚠️ **2** changed file(s) yielded no anchor (`packages/spec/api-surface/contracts.json`, `packages/spec/export-origins/contracts.json`), so the pages documenting them are **NOT COVERED by this run** — this is not a clean bill of health for those files.

**3** hand-written doc(s) NAME something this change touched and may need an implementation-accuracy re-verification:

- `content/docs/ai/knowledge-rag.mdx`  _(via KnowledgeService (symbol, a top-level class))_
- `content/docs/permissions/system-context.mdx`  _(via searchWithRefusals (symbol, a method of class KnowledgeService))_
- `content/docs/protocol/knowledge.mdx`  _(via AdapterSearchOptions (symbol, a top-level interface), KnowledgeHitSchema (symbol, a top-level const), KnowledgeSearchOptions (symbol, a top-level interface), KnowledgeService (symbol, a top-level class), runKnowledgeAdapterContract (symbol, a top-level function))_

<details><summary>What this run could not see</summary>

- **2** changed file(s) yielded no anchor (`packages/spec/api-surface/contracts.json`, `packages/spec/export-origins/contracts.json`) — pages documenting those are invisible to this run
- **2** anchor(s) matched too much of the corpus to be a work list: `VALIDATION_ERROR (literal, 38 pages)`, `master_detail (literal, 49 pages)`
- **5** name(s) were too generic to anchor anything (single lowercase words)
- the SDK route bridge reached **69** of **252** client-bound route-ledger rows — the other **183** have no registrar `path:` tail to select them, so pages documenting THEIR client methods cannot appear above, on this or any run. Of those **183**: **0** are remediable by widening that discovery convention (an in-repo file declares the path; the convention did not scan it); **59** are structural — on a ledger where NOT ONE row is declared in-repo, so no discovery change reaches them at any price; **124** are undecided (no in-repo declaration, on a ledger that has other in-repo registrars — absence and an unreadable spelling are not distinguishable here). The rows themselves: `node scripts/docs-audit/affected-docs.mjs --bridge-coverage`
- a page that states a rule by its **inputs** shares no identifier with the **emitter** that implements the rule, so an emitter-only diff cannot list it — not on this run and not on any run. Measured on #11430: `content/docs/protocol/objectql/types.mdx` documents the text-family column mapping by the ObjectQL type names it maps FROM (`text` / `textarea` / `html`) while the diff changed `createColumn`; it went unlisted, and it was the page that diff falsified, in four places. No shared token exists to detect this on, so a rule your change carries has to be re-read by hand in the pages that restate it.
- a key NAME is not a key, so the hand re-read the line above prescribes can land on the wrong schema. The same spelling is authorable on one governed type and a `[REMOVED]` tombstone on another for each of `active`, `aria`, `joins`, `objects`, `template`, `tools` and `version` (censused on #19093 over the liveness ledger's governed types, top-level keys); nothing in a search result distinguishes the two, so a grep hit on a LIVE example reads as evidence about the DEAD key. Measured on #19059: `content/docs/ai/agents.mdx` was reported as contradicting the `agent.tools` tombstone over its `tools:` example at `:161`, which is inside the `defineSkill({` block opened at `:155` — the page was already correct. Settle ownership by PARSING the value against both schemas, never by the name: that literal PASSES `SkillSchema`, and as an `AgentSchema` it FAILS at `tools` with the tombstone prescription. ⛔ These names are not the whole class — a key retired through a `.strict()` guidance map leaves no tombstone in the walked shape and none of them here (`tool.category`, live as `AIToolDefinition.category`).

Coarse fallback — **176** page(s) merely *mention* a changed package (the pre-#9192 predicate, kept for the deliberately-wide backstop): `node scripts/docs-audit/affected-docs.mjs --json 02520ab4808e46fa708ca257b11981499079d3ae` → `packageMentionDocs`.
</details>

<details><summary>Which tree this was computed on</summary>

This run read `content/docs` from `1dca7cd3c8a601a03e872fa9ba2078e48a1b55e5` — the merge of head `760716bcbbcc3e4a64ae9ecae9b710d76743b289` into base `02520ab4808e46fa708ca257b11981499079d3ae`, which is what `actions/checkout` gives a `pull_request` run. **Not** the PR head.

A worktree cut from an older `main` holds a different `content/docs`, so re-deriving there can legitimately return a different list — that is a **different tree, not a wrong row**. To answer on the same tree:

```sh
# while this PR is open — GitHub drops the merge commit once it closes
git fetch origin 1dca7cd3c8a601a03e872fa9ba2078e48a1b55e5 && git checkout 1dca7cd3c8a601a03e872fa9ba2078e48a1b55e5
# afterwards, rebuild it from the two parents, which stay fetchable
git fetch origin 02520ab4808e46fa708ca257b11981499079d3ae 760716bcbbcc3e4a64ae9ecae9b710d76743b289 && git checkout -B drift-repro 02520ab4808e46fa708ca257b11981499079d3ae && git merge --no-ff 760716bcbbcc3e4a64ae9ecae9b710d76743b289

node scripts/docs-audit/affected-docs.mjs --json 02520ab4808e46fa708ca257b11981499079d3ae
```

⚠️ That checkout carried **uncommitted changes**, so the commit above does not fully identify what was read.
</details>

> Advisory only, and a **precision-first** one (#9192): a page is listed because it names a
> symbol, wire route or SDK method this diff touched — not because it mentions a changed
> package. Each row says which anchor put it there, so a wrong row is reportable rather than
> merely annoying. To re-verify, run the `docs-accuracy-audit` workflow scoped to these files:
> `node scripts/docs-audit/affected-docs.mjs 02520ab4808e46fa708ca257b11981499079d3ae` → pass the list as
> `args.docs`, on the commit named under **Which tree this was computed on**.

## 维护者速读

- 这个 PR 做的事：知识检索可以限定范围，只在指定的几条记录里找，或者只在一份上级记录（比如一份制度）下面的条款里找。按您 Q3 选的 B 实现。
- 复核结论：设计和代码与 ADR 补充说明一致，范围只会缩小结果，不会放宽权限。但现在还不能合并，退回补两件事。
- 第一件：一项安全清点测试变红。新代码用了"查某个字段指向哪个对象"的公共函数，清点表要求每个使用方都登记。复核判断：这里只读条款自己的字段定义，不读上级记录，登记为"不提供目标对象内容的读取"是对的。登记要改一个认领范围之外的测试文件，dev 的改动被自动模式拦下，已请您在卡片线程里定。
- 第二件：按记录返回的那个 PR（#37335）已经合并，这个 PR 与主干有一行文字冲突，需要合入主干。复核试合过：两处过滤都保留，两个包的测试全过。
- 需要您做的：在卡片线程里同意把那一行登记加进安全清点表（或指定别的做法）。其余由座位跟进，新提交出来后再做一轮差量复核。

## 席位核对

Head-sha: `857a2e2024c14709e2da98fc910ef56168ca139f`

Read whole at this head against `13ffe1c04565150c174e88806c2fc32d70a04cc8` (the merge base): 15 files, +1160 / -22.

**形态**
- Open, draft, base `main`, first line `Fixes #37308`, the only closing keyword in the body. `Fixes` is right: the card's items 2 to 5 are delivered and item 1 landed as PR #37329.
- Body and changeset read `Clause-②: yes` · `Metadata-protocol: none`; `@objectstack/spec`, `@objectstack/service-knowledge` and `@objectstack/knowledge-memory` each `patch`. No metadata key is added, so `none` and `patch` follow AGENTS.md. `Skills-docs:` not owed.
- Not governed surface: `check-governed-merges.mjs --pr 37342` reads 0 of 15 paths on the register, 1182 changed lines, under the 3000 threshold. The three paths this record asks to add (below) also read 0 on `--test`.
- `mergeable_state` is `dirty`: PR #37335 merged as `3801775344e92632b84242161c541917fdb7eaff` after this head was pushed.

**门禁 check-runs** (at `857a2e20`, read 2026-11-25 about 19:45Z)
- 47 success, 10 skipped, 9 in progress, 1 failed. Lint & Repo Gates: success. Type Check · workspace: not measured (running). All-green: no.
- Failed: Test Core (9/10). `packages/core/src/security/second-object-read-exposure.pin.test.ts` line 580 does not know a new caller of `referenceTargetOf`, `packages/services/service-knowledge/src/knowledge-search-scope.ts`. Reproduced locally at this head; caused by this diff, not a flake.
- Local at `857a2e20`: `service-knowledge` vitest 323/323 (12 files), `knowledge-memory` 44/44 (2 files), as the report says.

**逐项核对与消融** (21 single-change ablations at this head in a scratch worktree, each restored; worktree removed)
1. Scene 1 (20 records, two in scope, `topK: 5`, a full page) — the service case and the suite case on `knowledge-memory`. Adapter filter removed: 7 suite cases red.
2. Scene 2 (an adapter that ignores the member) — after-answer check removed: 7 red in `service-knowledge`, 1 in `knowledge-memory`. Log-once guard removed: 4 red.
3. Scene 3 (an object no source reaches) — an unreached source left searched: 4 red. The answer type is the hit list alone; no count is in it.
4. Scene 4 (an unreadable scoped record) — pinned by its own case; the re-read is untouched by the diff.
5. Scene 5 (bounds) — entries bound raised: 3 red; ids bound raised: 3 red; `code` and `status` removed: 13 red. The cases assert `code`, `status` and the message.
6. Scene 6 (the suite) — runs on `knowledge-memory` and both stubs; no other in-tree adapter runs it at this head.
7. Carry-over 1 (metadata on hits) — `knowledge-memory` hits without `metadata`: 2 red. Text placement: see ruling (b).
8. Carry-over 2 (string compare) — strict compare in the service: 2 red; in the adapter: 2 red.
9. Carry-over 3 (empty scope) — three ablations (service list, service entry, adapter list): 1 red each.
10. Carry-over 4 (bounds on the member's TSDoc, coded refusal) — present on both TSDocs; pinned as scene 5.
11. Carry-over 5 (the opaque `filter` finding) — in the body's Acceptance notes, item 5.
12. Readings of the note — first-field-wins: 2 red; `user` as a link: 1 red; withheld field kept: 1 red; fail-open on a missing value: 3 red; unknown entry key ignored: 1 red; `file` / `http` source reached: 1 red.
13. Not pinned: the copy of the terms handed to the adapter (no case red when the live terms are handed). The self-target guard in `parentLinksOf` has no effect on the answer (no case red; the own-object branch returns first).

**dev 所提三问的裁定**
- (a) `packages/spec/api-surface/contracts.json` and `packages/spec/export-origins/contracts.json`: accepted deviation. One line each, the regen of the claimed `AdapterScopeTerm` export, required by `check:generated`.
- (b) `KnowledgeHit.metadata` TSDoc: the requirement on `AdapterSearchOptions.scope` plus the two pins meets carry-over 1 in substance. The hit-side sentence is still owed as should-fix 4, because an adapter that never reads `scope` reads the hit type. #37335 has landed, so the file is free: the seat extends the surface by that one TSDoc line in `packages/spec/src/ai/knowledge-document.zod.ts`, in the merge-main commit. No generated artifact copies that comment.
- (c) `scripts/adr-anchors`: no gate requires an entry. The registry is opt-in, `pnpm check:adr-anchors` passes without one, no knowledge file has one, and the touched files cite ADR-0161 in place. Not owed here and no follow-up owed.

**安全清点表的归类** (asked by the coordinator)
- The correct kind for `knowledge-search-scope.ts` is `not-a-served-read`. The file resolves a target name from the indexed object's own registered definition, compares it with the name the caller supplied, and reads no record and no definition of the target. The filter it produces is on the indexed object's own stored field, which source admission already holds to be queryable by the caller. `decided`, `executes` and `open` each describe a read of the target and do not fit.
- The row sits in `packages/core/src/security/second-object-read-exposure.pin.test.ts`, outside the claim. The dev's edit was refused by auto mode and the question is with the maintainer in the card thread; the seat does not apply it in the dev's place.

**逐句核的散文面**
- Changeset: every sentence true of the code. "now requires `implements.scope`" is a compile-time change for an outside caller of the suite; none exists in `objectstack-ai/cloud` (code search: 0), and #37256 set the same precedent with `organizationIds`.
- `content/docs/protocol/knowledge.mdx`, "Record scope": each bullet and both closing paragraphs true. The suite sample matches the new required key.
- `content/docs/ai/knowledge-rag.mdx`: true, with nit 8 on one sentence.

**修复清单**
1. must-fix — classify `knowledge-search-scope.ts` in the pin file as `not-a-served-read`, once the maintainer or the seat extends the surface to that file.
2. must-fix — merge `main`. One conflict, in `search()`: keep both source filters. Probe on the trial merge: 344/344 and 47/47.
3. should-fix — one case pinning that a parent scope asks the engine nothing about the parent object and that an adapter changing the terms it was handed does not change the service's check. The pin-file row can then cite it.
4. should-fix — the `KnowledgeHit.metadata` sentence of ruling (b).
5. should-fix — on `AdapterSearchOptions.scope`, "never taken from a caller's input as given" is true of the term shape and reads as if the ids were cleaned. Say that the ids are the caller's strings as given and are bound as parameters, and that `field` is a name from the source's `metadataFields`.
6. nit — no bound on the length of one id; the tool door (#37311) is the place.
7. nit — the self-target guard in `parentLinksOf` is unreachable in effect; keep or drop.
8. nit — the RAG guide says "The adapter filters before it ranks" for every adapter; the protocol page says "An adapter that reads the member".
9. nit — the ambiguity log is once per source and object; the note says once per source. Finer, not wider.

**接受的偏差**
- Ruling (a). An empty scope is answered empty, not refused. Bounds 10 by 500. An entry with a key besides `object` and `ids` is refused. `answered` stays the adapter's own count.

**范围外去向**
- The opaque `filter` (no producer, no service guarantee): seat's filing gate, as carried from #37329.
- `dispatch-gates --commands` derived 118 commands for this path set and none ran the `repo` project of `@objectstack/core`, which is where the red check lives. Seat's filing gate.
- #37337 (#37100): textual conflict stands; the second to land merges `main`, and `knowledge-pgvector` then owes `implements.scope`.

**落地条款**
- Clause-② declared and the path limb hit; the contract record below is FAIL at this head. Not queued. The new head is not prose-only and owes a delta record.

## Contract review

Served-tier: `CONTRACT_REVIEW_TIER`
Head-sha: `857a2e2024c14709e2da98fc910ef56168ca139f`
Local-runs: probe — the two package suites, 21 ablations, the failing pin test and a trial merge of `main` were run in a scratch worktree to confirm what is pinned and what the red check is; nothing was pushed.
Scope: packages/spec/src/contracts/knowledge-adapter.ts, packages/spec/src/contracts/knowledge-service.ts + packages/services/service-knowledge/src/knowledge-search-scope.ts, packages/services/service-knowledge/src/knowledge-service.ts, packages/services/service-knowledge/src/testing.ts, packages/plugins/knowledge-memory/src/index.ts, packages/spec/api-surface/contracts.json, packages/spec/export-origins/contracts.json
Security-touching: yes
Rule-change-verified: yes

### ① Derived judgments

- The member is the one the dated note of 2026-11-25 fixes and no other: `AdapterSearchOptions.scope?: AdapterScopeTerm[]`, a term being `{ kind: 'record', ids }` or `{ kind: 'metadata', field, ids }`. Absent, present and empty read as the note says, and the three filters all apply.
- `KnowledgeSearchOptions.scope` is a service option, which K8 names as not a member. `implements.scope` is a key of the suite's options, not a member.
- Rule 1 holds: the member lands with its first reader (`knowledge-memory`) and with suite cases for each term kind and through a real service. Rule 2 holds: optional, and an adapter that ignores it is reported once.
- The four readings of the note and "what a scope does not reach" are built as written. What the note left open is decided in the body's Acceptance notes and is inside the note's words.

### ② Semver level

- `Clause-②: yes` is right: two optional keys and one exported type widen the published contract. `Metadata-protocol: none` is right: nothing a metadata author writes changes. `patch` on the three packages follows the level rule.
- Additive-safe for existing adapters. `knowledge-ragflow` and cloud's `knowledge-turso` do not read the member and keep compiling and answering; both return `sourceRecordId` and `metadata` on hits, so the service's check keeps their scoped answers correct and possibly short of `topK`.
- The suite's new required `implements.scope` is a compile-time change for an outside caller; none found, precedent #37256, and the changeset states the fix.

### ③ Boundary flags

- Dev flags (a), (b), (c): ruled in the seat section. `open_questions`: none.
- New caller of the reference-target arbiter, unclassified in the census pin: must-fix 1. Kind `not-a-served-read` is correct.
- SQL push-down: no new id materialisation and no in-app join. The service filters at most one adapter answer per round, after the adapter; the note gives the reason (the index may live in another store). No finding.
- Author: PR `user.login` is `objectstack-fleet[bot]`.
- Overlap: #37335 merged; one-line conflict. #37337 open, draft, textual conflict.

### ④ Design judgment

`packages/spec/src/contracts/knowledge-adapter.ts`
- Holds against the note and against the first reader. Bounds and the hit-metadata requirement are on the member.
- should-fix 5 — the sentence on where the terms come from needs the id wording.

`packages/spec/src/contracts/knowledge-service.ts`
- Holds. Bounds, the empty reading and the coded refusal are stated and true of the code.

`packages/services/service-knowledge/src/knowledge-search-scope.ts`
- Agrees with the contract: bounds before anything else, terms per source from the indexed object's definition, hit check fail closed, string compare.
- must-fix 1 — the census classification. nit 7.

`packages/services/service-knowledge/src/knowledge-service.ts`
- Agrees: validation first, admission before the scope, every round checked, counts to logs only.
- must-fix 2 — merge `main`. should-fix 3 — the unpinned copy of the terms.

`packages/services/service-knowledge/src/testing.ts`, `packages/plugins/knowledge-memory/src/index.ts`
- Hold. The suite cases are the ones the note lists; the adapter filters before it ranks and returns `metadata`.

`packages/spec/api-surface/contracts.json`, `packages/spec/export-origins/contracts.json`
- The regen of the new export; hold.

Findings open at this head: two must-fix, three should-fix, four nits.
